name: dspy-appliance-data-pipeline
description: Vertical appliance: a pre-wired DSPy.ts ETL / classification pipeline. Ships a ready-to-run program — typed PredictModules composed in a Pipeline (e.g. clean → classify → extract), a CSV/JSONL batch loader, a row-level metric, and BootstrapFewShot tuning from a labeled CSV. Commands scaffold it into your repo, run a batch, and tune from labels.
